searches.reason: Find practical ways to learn finer item distinctions from available titles and descriptions using a jointly trained text encoder initialized from scratch. Keep one network per category and hide target identity and target text at supervised positions. This could address broad similarity without assuming unavailable compatibility or ownership labels.
